company.name: Fever
company.shortDescription: Fever is a live-entertainment discovery tech platform that enables users to discover and book various events, experiences, and attractions.
company.description: Fever operates a digital platform that enables users to discover and book tickets for a variety of live entertainment experiences, including concerts, immersive exhibitions, theater performances, and cultural events. The platform is accessible via web and mobile applications, offering personalized event recommendations based on user preferences and location. Fever collaborates with event organizers and brands to provide ticketing, marketing, and analytics services, facilitating the promotion and management of events. Additionally, the company offers tools for creating private events and corporate experiences, catering to business clients seeking customized entertainment solutions. Fever's services are available in multiple cities worldwide, supporting users in exploring local entertainment options.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Private Equity round raised $100,000,000, or 19.47% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,938,097 to $2,268,179,034, a 326.92x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 69 (-20 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
